name: create_ruby_sales_report
description: Builds a CSV sales aggregator (revenue per category, with row cleaning) consumed by an existing printer
prompts: An existing lib/report_printer.rb calls SalesReport.summarize(csv_text) and formats the result, but SalesReport does not exist yet. Create lib/sales_report.rb defining module App with class SalesReport and a class method summarize(csv_text) that parses CSV text with a header row `category,unit_price_cents,qty` and returns a Hash mapping each category (String) to its total revenue in integer cents, where a row's revenue is unit_price_cents * qty. Clean the data as you aggregate: skip any row whose category is empty or whitespace-only, whose qty is missing/non-integer/zero-or-negative, or whose unit_price_cents is missing/non-integer. Categories that appear on multiple rows accumulate. An input with only a header (or no valid rows) returns an empty Hash. Keep everything as integer cents (no floats). Do not modify report_printer.rb.

setup_files.lib/report_printer.rb:
require_relative "sales_report"

module App
  # Renders the per-category revenue totals as dollar lines, one per
  # category, sorted by category name. Delegates all aggregation to
  # SalesReport.summarize.
  class ReportPrinter
    def self.render(csv_text)
      totals = SalesReport.summarize(csv_text)
      totals.sort.map { |cat, cents| "#{cat}: $#{format('%.2f', cents / 100.0)}" }.join("\n")
    end
  end
end

test_setup_files.test/sales_report_test.rb:
require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/report_printer"

class SalesReportTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_aggregates_revenue_by_category
    csv = "category,unit_price_cents,qty\nbooks,500,2\nfood,250,4\nbooks,300,1\n"
    assert_equal({ "books" => 1300, "food" => 1000 }, App::SalesReport.summarize(csv))
  end

  def test_multiplies_price_by_quantity
    csv = "category,unit_price_cents,qty\nwidgets,199,3\n"
    assert_equal({ "widgets" => 597 }, App::SalesReport.summarize(csv))
  end

  def test_skips_dirty_rows
    csv = "category,unit_price_cents,qty\n" \
          "books,500,2\n" \
          ",999,1\n" \
          "   ,100,1\n" \
          "food,250,0\n" \
          "food,250,-2\n" \
          "toys,notanumber,3\n" \
          "toys,100,x\n"
    assert_equal({ "books" => 1000 }, App::SalesReport.summarize(csv))
  end

  def test_header_only_is_empty
    assert_equal({}, App::SalesReport.summarize("category,unit_price_cents,qty\n"))
  end

  def test_integration_with_printer
    csv = "category,unit_price_cents,qty\nbooks,500,2\nfood,250,4\n"
    assert_equal("books: $10.00\nfood: $10.00", App::ReportPrinter.render(csv))
  end
end

reference_solution.lib/sales_report.rb:
require "csv"

module App
  class SalesReport
    # Aggregate revenue (unit_price_cents * qty) per category from CSV text,
    # skipping rows with a blank category or a non-positive/invalid qty or an
    # invalid unit price. Returns a Hash of category => total integer cents.
    def self.summarize(csv_text)
      totals = Hash.new(0)
      CSV.parse(csv_text, headers: true) do |row|
        category = row["category"].to_s.strip
        next if category.empty?

        qty = Integer(row["qty"].to_s.strip, exception: false)
        next if qty.nil? || qty <= 0

        price = Integer(row["unit_price_cents"].to_s.strip, exception: false)
        next if price.nil?

        totals[category] += price * qty
      end
      totals
    end
  end
end

require "csv"

module App
  class SalesReport
    # BUG: coerces with to_i and does not skip invalid/blank/non-positive
    # rows, so blank categories and zero/negative/garbage quantities leak in.
    def self.summarize(csv_text)
      totals = Hash.new(0)
      CSV.parse(csv_text, headers: true) do |row|
        category = row["category"].to_s.strip
        qty = row["qty"].to_i
        price = row["unit_price_cents"].to_i
        totals[category] += price * qty
      end
      totals
    end
  end
end
